text:
Cheng: Quick sync — microbatching + KV perf sprint update. Need explicit owners for the kernel fast-path change (proto PR) and the KV warmup prefetch work. Short: small tail regression on long sequences; likely batching handshake + KV cold path.

Alice: Thanks. Can we list owners + blockers? Trying to update sprint board.

Cheng: Owner proposal: Ben -> kernel fast-path (PR touches kernel/batching/fastpath.cc), Priya -> KV warmup/prefetch. Blockers: eng-infra needs a new kernel-dev image with `-O3` build + CI flake on `test_batch_kv`.

Ben: I can own kernel fast-path but I'm out Tue-Wed. Will push an initial branch today for review. Needs Cheng for design review and eng-infra for build.

Priya: I'll take KV warmup. I have a local patch that bumps prefetch window to 32 (from 16). Local bench shows throughput +7% for seq=1024, but tail latency +~3ms under concurrent clients. Uploading artifacts shortly.

SRE Sam: Can you paste the bench output here so I can compare to canary baseline? Also, link the perf dashboard when available.

Priya: Paste of local run: ```
seq=1024, clients=8, iters=200
baseline: qps=1200, p95=42ms, p99=88ms
prefetch32: qps=1284, p95=45ms, p99=91ms
note: contention spikes at warmup boundaries
```

Alice: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.io/d/xyz/microbatching — I added a grafana panel for `batch_latency_tail` and an alert for p99>100ms.

eng-infra: Quick note: We can produce a kernel-dev image by today if PRs are merged. CI team flagged `test_batch_kv` flake: reproduces under heavy parallelism. Root cause appears to be a race in `kv_cache` initialization.

Ben: Hmm. I saw `AssertionError: kv_cache_miss != 0` in that test. I suspect the batch handshake path can sometimes skip prefetching due to inflight markers. Will add a defensive check in the test and a followup kernel fix.

Cheng: Proposed plan: (1) Ben opens PR with kernel fix + test hardening, tag Cheng & eng-infra; (2) Priya opens prefetch PR with perf artifacts and runbook; (3) joint review tomorrow 10:00 PT for API/semantics; (4) SRE to run e2e canary after merge. Does that timeline work?

Alice: Works for me. I'll block 10:00 PT and update the sprint ticket with owners/ETA.

SRE Sam: I'll provision a canary cluster and run the full harness after merge. Please add a `canary-checklist.md` to the PRs with steps and metrics to validate (p95/p99, mem, cpu, kv_miss).

Ben: I'll push branch `ben/microbatch-fastpath` by EOD and add test fix. Tagging @eng-infra for the image.

Priya: I'll open `priya/kv-prefetch-32` and upload the perf CSV to the dashboard (link will follow).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: build-2026-03-17-canary-01 (waiting on merge).

Cheng: Thanks everyone. If anyone needs to swap owners, ping here. We'll do the joint review and aim to have canary running tonight. Short action items in the ticket: Ben PR, Priya PR, eng-infra image, SRE canary runs.

Alice: Quick reminder — please include a short changelog line for the console release notes (latency/throughput tradeoffs).

Ben: Noted. Will add changelog and a short rollback plan.

Priya: Uploaded perf artifacts: https://dash.redwood.io/d/xyz/microbatching?panelId=7&orgId=1 (will paste raw CSV in PR).

SRE Sam: I'll post canary run results here once complete.

Cheng: Closing loop — next sync after canary results. Thanks!
